Voidbound Refulgent Copper
5 yd range

Copper veins have long populated Azeroth. Through a combination of advances in Mining techniques and copper veins bathing in magical energies, the newly-dubbed Refulgent Copper is quickly becoming an essential metal in Quel'Thalas.

Adventurers are no strangers to the Void and its adverse effects. Nothing can escape its touch, from dragon aspects to humble ore deposits. Gathering Voidbound ore provokes it, causing the swirling energies to coalesce into a terrifyi- [the entry suddenly cuts off].
